# Game Idea: Meteor Dodge

A simple HTML canvas game where the player controls a spaceship at the bottom of the screen, moving left and right to avoid falling meteors. Meteors spawn at random positions from the top and fall down at increasing speed. The game ends when a meteor collides with the ship. The score is the number of meteors avoided (time survived).

<content>
1: // Simple Meteor Dodge game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas) return; // canvas must exist
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8:   // create star field for background
9:   const stars = Array.from({length:100},()=>({
10:     x: Math.random()*W,
11:     y: Math.random()*H,
12:     radius: Math.random()*1.5+0.5
13:   }));
14:   // audio assets (data URIs)
15:   const hitSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRigAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // short beep
16:   const spawnSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRigAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
17:   const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRigAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
18:   bgMusic.loop = true;
19:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
20:   bgMusic.play();
21: 
22:   // Player ship
23:   const ship = { w:40, h:20, x:W/2-20, y:H-30, speed:5 };
24:   const keys = { left:false, right:false };
25:   let audioStarted = false;
26:   const startAudio = ()=>{ if(!audioStarted){ bgMusic.play(); audioStarted = true; } };
27:   document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ startAudio(); if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')keys.left=true; if(e.key==='ArrowRight')keys.right=true;});
28:   document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')keys.left=false; if(e.key==='ArrowRight')keys.right=false;});
29: 
30:   // Meteors
31:   const meteors = [];
32:   let spawnTimer=0, spawnInterval=60, // frames
33:       elapsed=0, lastTime=0,
34:       gameOver=false;
35: 
36:   function spawn(){
37:     const size = 20+Math.random()*30;
38:     meteors.push({x:Math.random()*(W-size), y:-size, size, speed:2+elapsed*0.02});
39:     // play spawn sound
40:     spawnSound.currentTime = 0;
41:     spawnSound.play();
42:   }
43:   function update(dt){
44:     if(keys.left) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x-ship.speed);
45:     if(keys.right) ship.x = Math.min(W-ship.w, ship.x+ship.speed);
46:     // meteors
47:     for(let i=meteors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
48:       const m=meteors[i];
49:       m.y += m.speed;
50:       // collision
51:       if(m.x < ship.x+ship.w && m.x+m.size > ship.x && m.y < ship.y+ship.h && m.y+m.size > ship.y){
52:         // play hit sound on collision
53:         hitSound.currentTime = 0;
54:         hitSound.play();
55:         gameOver=true;
56:       }
57:       // remove off-screen
58:       if(m.y>H) meteors.splice(i,1);
59:     }
60:     spawnTimer++;
61:     if(spawnTimer>=spawnInterval){ spawnTimer=0; spawn(); }
62:     elapsed += dt/1000;
63:   }
64:   function draw(){
65:     // background gradient
66:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
67:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0,'#001');
68:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1,'#000');
69:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
70:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
71:     // star field (twinkling)
72:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
73:     stars.forEach(s=>{
74:       const twinkle = Math.random()*0.5+0.5;
75:       ctx.globalAlpha = twinkle;
76:       ctx.beginPath();
77:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI*2);
78:       ctx.fill();
79:     });
80:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
81:     // ship (triangle)
82:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
83:     ctx.beginPath();
84:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
85:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w/2, ship.y);
86:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
87:     ctx.closePath();
88:     ctx.fill();
89:     // meteors with gradient
90:     meteors.forEach(m=>{
91:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
92:         m.x + m.size/2, m.y + m.size/2, m.size*0.1,
93:         m.x + m.size/2, m.y + m.size/2, m.size/2
94:       );
95:       grad.addColorStop(0,'#faa');
96:       grad.addColorStop(1,'#800');
97:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
98:       ctx.beginPath();
99:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.size/2, m.y + m.size/2, m.size/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
100:       ctx.fill();
101:     });
102:     // score
103:     ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
104:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
105:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+Math.floor(elapsed),10,20);
106:     if(gameOver){
107:       ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
108:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
109:       ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
110:       ctx.font='30px sans-serif';
111:       ctx.fillText('Game Over',W/2-80,H/2);
112:     }
113:   }
114:   function loop(timestamp){
115:     if(!lastTime) lastTime=timestamp;
116:     const dt = timestamp-lastTime;
117:     lastTime=timestamp;
118:     if(!gameOver){
119:       update(dt);
120:       draw();
121:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
122:     } else {
123:       draw();
124:     }
125:   }
126:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
127: })();

(End of file - total 127 lines)
</content>
